last.verdict: Pfizer raised its 2026 revenue and profit outlook as newer cancer and heart drugs grew fast, though COVID products keep shrinking.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rises $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B. Adjusted EPS guidance moves to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, even after a roughly $0.10 licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Flat quarter, strong core
takeaways.text: Revenue of $16.6B was flat and adjusted EPS held at $0.87, but sales excluding COVID products grew 7%, and newer and acquired products grew 32%.

takeaways.label: Eliquis and cancer drive growth
takeaways.text: Eliquis sales rose 25% (lower rebates helped), and the cancer drug Padcev rose 55%. COVID treatment Paxlovid fell 63%, the COVID vaccine fell 29%, and the Prevnar vaccine fell 10%.

takeaways.label: Spending on pipeline rises
takeaways.text: R&D spending jumped 18%, mainly for cancer and obesity drugs. R&D guidance rose to $10.8-11.8B. A new CFO, Cecile Guegan, started Nov. 1; no share buybacks are planned this year.

history.verdict: Earnings beat and a higher revenue outlook gave shares a modest lift.

reasons.label: Beat on profit
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.77 beat the roughly $0.68 analysts expected; revenue was $15.0B.

reasons.label: Revenue outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $500M at the midpoint, to $60.5-$62.5B.

reasons.label: COVID sales shrinking
reasons.text: COVID product sales forecast cut to about $4B from $5B, capping enthusiasm.
